detaileddescription.para: System Control (SysCtl) determines the overall operation of the device. The API provides functions to configure the clocking of the device, the set of peripherals that are enabled, the windowed watchdog, and low-power modes. It also provides functions to handle and obtain information about resets and missing clock detection failures.

sect1.title: Example Usage
sect1.para: Include the below file to access the APIs #include <sysctl.h>
